caption: The drawing shows three views of a pitcher rendered in shades of brown, tan, and beige on a plain light background. The pitcher has a faceted, vertically ridged exterior. At the top right, there is a three-quarter perspective view showing the overall shape, handle, and spout of the pitcher. Below that, in the lower right, is a top-down view showing the oval opening and the dark interior of the vessel, along with the handle and the pointed spout. To the left, a straight-on view from the side displays the full height, vertical facets, handle, and spout. There is text beneath the objects indicating maximum height (7 1/4 inches) and maximum width (6 3/8 inches), as well as a signature at the bottom left. The composition is arranged so the three separate views of the pitcher are presented clearly on the page, each rendered with gradual shading to show volume and texture.
title: Bishop Hill: Pitcher
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
